title: Alder's Leave: Stars
introNarration: Lumen rolls the chart you have been working from and ties it, then writes your name on the outside of it. "Three lessons, and your last bearing was within a degree. I have kept worse charts from older students." She sets the roll aside. "Talk to Headmaster Alder in the High Study, up from the Great Hall. If he has you on the Clock Tower stair, finish that first. When he says the grounds will teach the rest, come back and talk to me."
reminderNarration: Talk to Alder in the High Study, then come back and talk to Lumen. Your chart is rolled and tied with your name on it.
completionNarration: Lumen rules a line and inks Alder's leave under the Stars stem along it. "The college part is closed. The grounds teach the rest, and each lesson out there leaves one ink in the book for you to spend." She puts a small glass ring on top of your rolled chart. "That is for counting, not for seeing. Take both. Eat something warm before you walk a cold road."

objectives.label: Return and talk to Mentor Lumen.
